category_edits.rationale: Add a jointly trained residual feed-forward block after each GRU output, with default widths 128→256→128 and a zero-initialized output projection. This initially preserves the recurrent representation while allowing nonlinear refinement. Apply identically during training and inference across all four datasets. Preserve normalized tied embeddings, final-real-position readout, dot-product scoring, loss, optimizer and training limits. The predictor writer already imports GRU4RecModel from train.py, so it constructs the updated architecture and loads its added checkpoint parameters consistently.

        self.residual_ff = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_units, 2 * hidden_units),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(2 * hidden_units, hidden_units),
        )
        nn.init.zeros_(self.residual_ff[2].weight)

def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + self.residual_ff(out)

def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + self.residual_ff(out)
